summary: E2E + API testing for the new Athlete Progress enhancements: META/OBJETIVO line + sponsor logos in PDF & public link. Tested against the public preview URL with Super Admin. 9 backend tests written (8/9 PASS); 1 backend bug found: DELETE /api/calculator-results/goal is shadowed by DELETE /api/calculator-results/{rid} due to FastAPI route declaration order. Frontend flow PASSES end-to-end: goal-input → goal-progress-bar (60% for 130 vs 110→122), ReferenceLine 'Meta 130' rendered in chart and in public report, sponsor upload chip rendered, sponsor delete works, PDF download (3867B, %PDF header), share link generated, /progress/p/{id} public page shows public-goal + public-sponsors + 'Meta 130' line.

minor.issue: Route is unreachable — shadowed by DELETE /api/calculator-results/{rid} which is declared earlier in routes/calculator_results.py (line 102 vs line 138). Request returns 404 'Resultado no encontrado' (from delete_result()) instead of the goal-deletion handler. Goals therefore can't be removed once set. UI currently only POSTs (upsert) /goal so user-facing impact is limited, but leaves orphaned goals in DB. Fix: move @router.delete('/{rid}') below all specific-path routes, or rename to @router.delete('/result/{rid}'), or use a path-prefix constraint.

action_items: Fix DELETE /api/calculator-results/goal route ordering in /app/backend/routes/calculator_results.py — declare /goal handlers BEFORE /{rid} (currently /{rid} at line 102 swallows DELETE /goal). After fix, add a UI 'Quitar meta' button if desired (currently only POST upsert is wired).
critical_code_review_comments: calculator_results.py — Route ordering bug: @router.delete('/{rid}') is registered before @router.delete('/goal'), so the latter never matches. FastAPI matches routes in registration order. Same risk would apply if a future @router.delete('/sponsors/{sid}') were added below /{rid}; thankfully it is registered before via the path-prefix '/sponsors/'.
_build_series progress_pct formula: when target_value == first_value the divisor is 0 and falls through to 0/100. This is a sensible guard; OK.

Sponsors are coach-scoped (not athlete-scoped), so the same logos appear in every athlete's progress modal/PDF/public page for that coach. Confirm this is intentional (coach brand) — UI label is 'Patrocinadores del informe (aparecen en el PDF y el enlace público)' which suggests global-per-coach, so OK.

AthleteProgress.js (~310 lines) — clean, single-responsibility, full data-testid coverage. PublicProgress.js mirrors it. Token retrieval via localStorage('train_token') consistent with the rest of the app.
Sponsor logo size cap 4MB is reasonable; MIME whitelist covers jpg/png/webp/gif/svg. Defaults to 'png' when content_type missing — acceptable.

rca of the issue: DELETE /goal route shadowed by DELETE /{rid}. Root cause: FastAPI uses first-match routing on registration order. In /app/backend/routes/calculator_results.py the generic delete_result is declared at line 102 with path '/{rid}' (path param accepts ANY string), then delete_goal at line 138 with path '/goal'. The literal 'goal' is captured by {rid}, so the goal-deletion handler is dead code. Reproduction: curl -X DELETE "$URL/api/calculator-results/goal?athlete_id=x&calculator=y&metric_label=z" -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' → returns 404 with detail 'Resultado no encontrado' (the delete_result message, not the goal handler). Mitigation: re-order the routes so all literal paths (/goal, /sponsors, /sponsors/{sid}, /series, /share, /public/{...}, /progress-pdf, /sponsor-logo/{sid}) are declared BEFORE the catch-all @router.delete('/{rid}'). Alternative: change the result-deletion route to a more specific prefix like '/result/{rid}'.
